first_attempt: only; preserve spontaneous alternatives and engineering failures; no account payment or API key
charged_route: official Codex ChatGPT OAuth using local Clash; no additional credits
material_split: Two exact timeSeries subobjects of hydro/a/usgs.json, with provenance only. Only first-station.json is attached at admission. No second-station readings or outcome in topic or visible instructions. See code for extraction coordinates.
delivery_rule: Select an OPEN worker by its Lead-written appointment referring to archive/source/metadata/provenance/data/check, taking earliest eligible assignment otherwise. Wait for a substantive initial Run Lead decision, signed peer hint, or module report, together with a live recipient. At 150 seconds after first open appointment, deliver regardless of initial-judgment availability. Fallback if no open recipient after 330s, provide the attachment to Run Lead and record missing scoped handoff. Never re-open or replace a sealed Run.
disconnect: Immediately before filing the second station, terminate only this trial GX Driver. Record pre-crash graph/Job/worker state. Use official message --queue-only with stable message_id/branch and one UTF-8 attachment, then public resume --run-id on exactly the same DB/Run. No replayed scientific outputs or SQL mutation. Existing provider sessions and Job handles remain available to GX.

grade.early_basis: A timestamped pre-delivery accepted decision, original researcher message or report must say what can be judged and what remains missing. Unbound plan alone does not earn this point.
grade.peer: Original words, actual receipt by another live researcher and a subsequent attributable action. Merely publishing or subscribing does not earn the action.
grade.changed_search: After receiving the new input, the same peer performs an evidenced new catalog query, source search/inspection or measurement with changed question, target or inputs. Count literal new catalog search separately; a repeated query, a hint alone or only Lead action is insufficient.
grade.formal_local_reopen: Requires actual provisional converge/resolve event and later reopen_intent on same ID with increasing revision and newly delivered grounds. A semantic revision in prose is reported separately.
grade.recovery: Original Run ID and original committed decisions, any accepted Job IDs/operation keys/inputs must survive. Report duplicate external admissions, pending unrelated work disturbance, and cases where no in-flight external Job exists.
grade.science: Independent computation from archived daily mean values: first-to-last relative drop per station, compare without inferring storm cause or continuous subdaily dynamics; retain numerical/qualifier limitations.

purpose: engineering recheck only; first scientific trial stays as observed
positive_delivery: An official receiving scope sees the new artifact ref and human words in its native tool context or acknowledged brief after recovery. Check separately that it inspects actual second-station rows and acts on them.
